promises.target: exceeding our full year FY '26 guidance of 10% growth in group order inflows for the current year
promises.quote: We are confident of exceeding our full year FY '26 guidance of 10% growth in group order inflows for the current year.
Accordingly, we maintain our full year revenue growth guidance at 15%.

promises.target: full year EBITDA margin target of 8.5%
promises.quote: With the execution momentum expected to pick up in H2, we are reasonably confident to achieve our full year EBITDA margin target of 8.5%.

promises.target: guidance for working capital for FY '26 remains unchanged at around 12% by March 2026
promises.quote: On Working Capital, our guidance for working capital for FY '26 remains unchanged at around 12% by March 2026.

reported.quote: We continue to witness strong ordering activity in Q2 FY '26 across India and the Middle East, with order inflows growing 45% Y-on-Y.
Supported by this sustained momentum, the order book expanded to Rs 6.67 trillion as of September 2025, reflecting a 31% Y-on-Y increase
Our group revenues grew 10% Y-o-Y in Q2 FY '26.
The Projects & Manufacturing portfolio margin improved from 7.6% in Q2 of the previous year to 7.8% in Q2 FY '26.

reported.metric: Net Working Capital to Revenue ratio
reported.quote: As of September 2025, the Net Working Capital to Revenue ratio remained healthy at 10.2%, an improvement of almost 200 basis points Y-on-Y.
Our continued emphasis on capital efficiency also translated into a further improvement in the Return on Equity, which rose to 17.2%, up 110 basis points Y-o-Y.
During the quarter, the group order inflow stood at Rs 1,158 billion, registering a Y-on-Y growth of 45%
The Group Revenues for Q2 FY '26 at Rs 680 billion registered a Y-on-Y growth of 10%.
Our Consolidated PAT for Q2 FY '26 at Rs 39 billion is up by 16% as compared to Q2 of the previous year.
The ROAs remain healthy at 2.4% for Q2 FY '26

quarter_margin.name: Group level EBITDA margin without other income
quarter_margin.quote: The Group level EBITDA margin without other income for Q2 FY '26 is 10.0% as compared to 10.3% in Q2 of the previous year.
